rowId.description: Optional proposed client row locator; absence uses the preserved zero-based input array index. Uniqueness is a runtime rule, not phone/lead identity.

phone.description: Proposed string preserving the submitted phone; actual format/encryption/normalization require engineering agreement, no sample-specific regex.

priority.description: Required platform value, no default. Supplier TaskTel priority is Int, default 0, greater means higher, maximum 999999 (SRC073 live-312.txt L37). Minimum 0 and strict integer wire type are THIS candidate proposal; the cited page does not explicitly state a minimum.

R.description: Optional metadata, no dictionary/enum/default and no authority or callback-routing meaning. Length/safe encoding unknown.

isNewBatch.description: Only omission normalizes to false; default is an annotation and validators do not insert it. null/0/1/string are invalid, not coerced.

ImportValidRow.description: Proposed per-row validator. Do not use as the request rows/items schema: invalid rows must remain in the request and receive individual receipts.

taskId.description: Proposed original supplier task identifier wire type, not a local remapped task. Supplier import taskId Int is SRC073 L24; positive-only restriction and local wire type remain proposed.

requestId.description: Request-level business identity; candidate namespace trusted tenant+stable app+operation+requestId. taskId is compared content, not a namespace dimension.

rows.description: Preserve every complete raw JSON row, including malformed/non-object rows. Each item is separately checked by ImportValidRow and service business guards. Proposed nonempty list; limits unknown.

SharedImportRequest.description: Only the envelope is validated here. Authenticated tenant/stable app/source are server context, not caller-selected body fields. Closed envelope is a proposal requiring compatibility agreement; rows intentionally accept any parsed JSON item.

rowId.description: Proposed nonempty identifier string; exact encoding/length limits remain unconfirmed.

x-proposal-decisions.unresolved: 现有网关、密钥存储/签发、稳定app解析、tokenTTL及撤权策略；等待工程评审，不替代031。

x-proposal-decisions.proposal: 本方record/batch、tenant/app及request等标识候选采用非空string；原供应商taskId在共用导入/回传候选中采用integer，不新建本地任务ID或重映射。实际类型/限制与历史调用兼容待评审。
x-proposal-decisions.unresolved: 与现有调用方数字/string兼容及历史数据规范；不据此重写正式契约。

x-proposal-decisions.decision: OpenAPI 3.1-compatible JSON Schema objects under components/schemas; refs use #/components/schemas/Name. This package specifies no actual method/path/server/security scheme.

rows.items={} intentionally allows all parsed JSON; each raw item independently validates ImportValidRow, then saved business guards. Only JSON/envelope structural or authorization failure is whole-request rejection; bad row alone never makes the entire new request invalid.

Strict positive integer taskId, nonempty identifier strings, strict priority integer 0..999999, optional string R/rowId, closed named objects and nonempty rows are proposed engineering choices, not production facts. No max length/row count/request size, phone regex, token TTL or HTTP code is invented.

SRC073 official cached import page live-312.txt L24(taskId), L26(request priority) and L37(TaskTel priority) documents Int/default0/larger-higher/max999999. Platform priority is required and never defaults. No explicit minimum appears in that cited text; candidate minimum0 requires confirmation, not a supplier verified lower bound. Supplier optional/default semantics do not weaken platform requiredness.
x-proposal-decisions.raw_ref: https://wiki.alicti.cn/html/wiki/API/预测式外呼/任务号码导入接口.html

x-proposal-decisions.decision: Stable zero-based rowIndex in each receipt preserves even malformed input row position; rowId optional candidate client alias, never phone/lead identity. Duplicate rowId policy remains proposed runtime rejection/pending of colliding rows, not a schema uniqueItems over records.

Preserve ordered complete parsed JSON rows including invalid/unknown fields. Only add isNewBatch:false to object rows where the property is absent; never coerce an invalid flag or inject priority/R. Compare canonical JSON with object key order ignored and arrays ordered; exact strings/types kept. Duplicate JSON object member keys must be detected before parse and rejected as ambiguous whole JSON, or a formally agreed equivalent must be defined; no drop-before-compare.

Current auth tenant/stable app/original task permission/mode first; key candidate=(trusted tenant, trusted stable app, IMPORT, requestId). taskId and all raw row content participate in comparison. Same stable app with new valid token is same scope; different app is isolated. Same normalized complete content returns original stored receipt/map including invalid/pending rows, no new supplier request and no latest-root reselection; changed full content rejects the whole repeat.

Accepted row stores trusted original app/source server-side. Only original DCC record/its internal attempt is eligible for fixed DCC delivery via API010; TW/manual local, unknown/conflict pending. Local ACK and supplier evidence remain independent; no vendor params/fileId input or supply state inferred from aggregate success.
根代理补入当前API001 response_fields对应的保存tenant/task与有效行leadCode/phone回显；具体字段层级为候选，数据必须来自原保存回执。同ID重放不得刷新这些值。

x-proposal-decisions.reason: 区分准确客户call三态与可能无call/fileId的导入/内部失败进度，不能冒充供应商状态。

x-proposal-decisions.candidate: association和平台进度字段ID类型、required集合、state编码
x-proposal-decisions.reason: 候选本方/tenant/lead/请求/行/record/batch/root标识string，原supplier taskId为integer minimum1（候选限值）；fileId/callId/eventRef/attempt不全局必填。格式/历史兼容待双方，原providerResult字段类型不改。
测试包装读取服务端不可变原来源；不增对DCC字段或前台body source/回调配置。
保原供应商字段及类型，尚无结果不补值；raw是否完整未改写需证据校验，schema无法证明。
对齐导入与同步回执行位置，原rowRef仅可选兼容。回传带原保存tenant/task/lead/phone；CALL_RESULT需call或稳定event引用，IMPORT_RESULT/FAILURE_PROGRESS不强填未发生通话。结构不证明来源或关联真实性。

x-unverified-runtime-rules.rule: Authentication/current tenant/task/mode/known stable app checks run before lookup or row processing; unauthorized replay cannot reveal prior receipts. Actual auth/TTL/token revocation/source migration unknown.

All rows including invalid input are canonically compared; same ID changed missing-priority row, added/deleted/reordered row, changed taskId or unknown field creates whole-request conflict without overwriting receipt or any new supplier call.

Same app new valid token returns exact old mapping/root even after a later main; different authenticated app same requestId has independent technical map but same accurate business group/failure four-tuple budget.

Root/batch equality for main, latest saved main for child, rowIndex count/order/uniqueness, original phone/lead historical consistency and persisted atomic mappings require service/database checks; schema is insufficient.
isNewBatch default annotation does not execute normalization. true/false differences and nonBoolean invalid values retained; priority missing remains invalid and R omitted remains omitted.
Local row ACCEPTED is not supplier accepted/called. Synchronous aggregate result0/import totals and 53 fragments do not fabricate per-row success/fileId/actual stable call or callback authority.
Immutable original source per record/attempt; TW/manual no external callback; source unknown no DCC default; later root/app/source display changes cannot rewrite the old record.
The schema cannot prove production persistence/concurrency/idempotency retention/token compatibility/ACK reliable delivery/supplier behavior or close ISSUE002/026/031/036.

x-unverified-runtime-rules: 真实原来源与精确record/attempt/call或稳定事件关联只能读验真服务端保存事实；schema literal DCC/true不能证明身份或授权，TW/manual/unknown无交付对象。
三态正确性依客户接通/主动挂断/客户有效时长的可信来源与单位及整体证据冲突；schema通过不证明分类正确，也不以缺失为可信false。
只有真实新证据/进度变化提高同对象resultVersion；纯重复和补送复用原ID/version/content，旧ACK仅确认自身旧版，不回退当前视图。
ACK必须匹配实际发送的resultId/resultVersion且accepted严格true并已可靠保存；形状合法的错ID/错版、accepted=false或HTTP成功均不确认。
原vendor status/SIP/空值不能被平台分类覆盖，providerResult与原受控证据逐值/摘要对照仍待实现验证。
失败共享首次外2次账按同tenant/task/保存lead/fixedphone，不随app/root/file改变；used/reserved/available算术和真实实际发起/未知/取消互斥无法仅靠此结构证明。
自动三类120秒从首次可信确认起算；WAIT_MANUAL无需运营确认先保存，本地保存/策略不依DCCACK，八人工无统一120秒。
秒挂分类/结果补送不新建供应商提交、计划、预算、内部业务attempt/子批，不修改原生任务重呼。

x-unverified-runtime-rules.rule: 服务端验证应用对指定租户的授权、原任务归属与当前权限；业务token不授予后台管理权，任务不绑应用；来源从认证与保存事实读取。
本候选不得直接供原型或生产消费；采用时按相应分析阶段更新正式接口事实并履行复核与门禁。
